test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If 7 % 3 = 28 and 5 % 1 = 20, then 8 % 3 = ?
solution:
a % b = a × (a – b)

Check it:

 
• 7 % 3 → 7 × (7 − 3) = 7 × 4 = 28
 
• 5 % 1 → 5 × (5 − 1) = 5 × 4 = 20

Now apply the rule:

8 % 3 = 8 × (8 − 3) = 8 × 5 = 40

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
